What should I do if the tracking never updates?
If your tracking status isn't updating, it often means the package is awaiting its initial carrier scan or a new label was created.
If there is no tracking movement for more than 2 consecutive business days past your expected timeframe, please share your order number and email address so I can look into your order directly.

Do you compensate for a long delay?
While we do not offer general monetary compensation for shipping delays, if your package has had no tracking movement for more than 2 consecutive business days past its expected delivery timeframe, we will be glad to escalate your order to our team for further investigation.
If you purchased VEF Package Protection with your order, it also covers issues with packages lost in transit.
